name: deck-changed
body: Event: a file changed while serving — under slides/, assets/, kalide.yaml, or under the resolved library's structure (the configured `templates:` path, else the local `templates/`; its library.yaml and its slides/, sections/, themes/, media/ subtrees are the library's structure, and any other top-level entry in the library root is inert; see library-guide-layout). Published (debounced) by watch-deck; triggers templates reload → validate → render. A change to the configured `templates:` value is a distinct restart-required condition: the session keeps its startup-pinned library root and the server shows the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart, global.constraint.never-serve-broken-deck).
